task: Pin the project rail to the left and the project panel to the right, and delete the settings that let either move.
acceptanceCriteria: the project rail is always on the left and its edge is not a setting
the project panel is always on the right and cannot be moved by menu or action
no settings key survives that is read by nothing
the shipped defaults give a new user that layout, with git and outline riding the rail
no behaviour outside the sidebar layout changes
every gate in the plan passes and no test is lost
blastRadius: The SidebarSide type was public API re-exported from `workspace`, so removing it reaches 6 crates. default.json is authoritative and from_settings unwraps every field, so a removed key without its resolved field is a startup panic. Four defaults had to flip in one commit: flipping the rail without flipping outline and git leaves the rail drawn but empty, with no error and no empty state. Workspace::activate_pane_in_direction had nine branches on the rail's side and no test reached the function.
contracts: Workspace::OWN_COLUMN_POSITION is the single place the layout is named
Workspace::own_column_position() and own_column_max_width() lost their cx argument
SidebarRenderState lost `side` and `occupies()`; the Sidebar/SidebarHandle `side()` trait methods and MultiWorkspace::sidebar_side are gone
dock.rs gained dockable_positions(panel, cx), which returns an empty vec below two valid edges
move_to_next_position wraps within the valid list instead of falling back to a literal Left
the `Sidebar Toggled` telemetry event lost its `side` property
